svg.title: Which updates of Renovate merge on their own
svg.desc: Every update, a major one too, waits a week after its release and then merges on its own once every check passes. An update that fixes a vulnerability comes at once and merges on its own. The weekly refresh of the lock files of npm and pip-compile keeps to versions a week old and merges on its own as well. The refresh of a package manager that can't keep to that age, such as Composer, brings the newest version of every indirect dependency, without a week of waiting, so it waits for the maintainer.
